reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model MK04, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The serial number BN83694552 falls in the recalled serial range (starts with BN), and the date code June 2025 is prior to July 2025, so both are in range.
The claimed purchase date of 2024-06-18 is before the sale window (2024-09-01 to 2025-06-30), so the purchase cannot be covered by the program.
The claimed retailer, Corner Hardware Co, is not on the list of sales channels (Amazon.com, Shopify.com, TEMU.com, TikTok.com).
No duplicate claims were found sharing a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account.
